players.name: Andre Drummond
players.inj: Drummond (head) did not return to Wednesday's 121-102 win over the Cavaliers.

players.name: Cade Cunningham
players.inj: Cunningham (knee) is listed as out for Tuesday's game against Orlando.

players.name: Aaron Nesmith
players.inj: Nesmith is out for Monday's game against the Thunder due to right foot soreness.

players.name: T.J. McConnell
players.inj: McConnell (hamstring) was recalled from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Tuesday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Larry Nance Jr.
players.inj: Nance exited Monday's game against the Thunder due to a sore right ankle and he will not return, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

players.name: Joel Embiid
players.inj: Embiid (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against Miami, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

players.name: Jaylen Brown
players.inj: Brown (hamstring) will receive imaging, and the Sixers will provide an update Thursday, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

players.name: LaMelo Ball
players.inj: Ball (ankle) did not return to Wednesday's 113-106 win over the Thunder.

players.inj: Fox (shin) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Portland, Jeff McDonald of the San Antonio Express-News reports.

players.name: Jaxson Hayes
players.inj: Hayes (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Lakers.

players.name: Julian Reese
players.inj: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.
